title: Failed-checkpoint integration test conflates inference errors with evaluation failures
reasoning: The agent raises RuntimeError on its first checkpoint while evaluation also returns a failing report. Stopping on the inference error alone satisfies the assertions, even if stopping after an ordinary test failure is broken. The visible end-to-end scenarios exercise successful runs, so they do not resolve this ambiguity.
reproduction: Allow continuation after failed evaluation while retaining the inference-error stop condition; this scenario can still pass.
recommendation: Separate inference-error handling from evaluation-failure continuation using a successful agent and explicit continuation settings.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The failure scenario activates both stop conditions simultaneously, and the remaining visible integration scenarios focus on exceptions or missing inference results.
suggestedRegressionTest: Extend the integration scenarios with successful inference and failed evaluation under ALL_CASES, asserting that the next checkpoint is skipped when continuation is false and executed when continuation is true, while the failed checkpoint remains unsolved.
